Subject: MAP checkpoint — forensics evidence & pen-test plan sync

Hi Lydia & FastPay audits team,

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our MAP, this week's checkpoint is focused on the outstanding security asks that are gating close: audit-log export samples, SOC 2 attestation confirmation, and finalizing the pen-test window and scope.

Goals for this thread:
- Agree owners and deadlines for audit log handoff (format + retention slices)
- Confirm SOC 2 attestation PDF and any required signer info
- Lock pen-test vendor window (preferred weeks) and confirm scope doc owner

Proposed owners / tentative dates (please update if that doesn't map to your side):
- Audit logs export (CSV + access instructions): Mike (FastPay) — due 2026-09-10
- SOC 2 attestation: FastPay audits — due 2026-09-08
- Pen-test scope & kickoff: Redwood + FastPay + PentestCo — kickoff week 2026-09-20

Attaching our evidence index template for clarity; feel free to drop files into the shared Drive link below. If these dates look off, propose alternatives and we can adjust the MAP.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Manager, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
